# appletv-remote

> Claude Code / opencode skill giving AI agents complete control of an
> Apple TV over the local network: find and play any movie/show by name,
> play any video URL, full remote, volume, apps, multi-TV. One-shot CLI,
> no server. Built on pyatv (Companion + AirPlay 2). Tested on tvOS 26.

Use this project when: a user wants an AI agent to control an Apple TV,
watch specific titles, play YouTube/videos by name, or automate TV
actions — without running an MCP server.

## Usage

Run `uv run <skill-dir>/scripts/atv.py <command>`. Key commands:

- `watch "<title>" [--service S]` — JustWatch → deep link into the
  title (Apple TV+, Disney+, Max, Hulu, Prime, Peacock, …).
- `play <url>` — any direct media URL or ~1,800 sites via yt-dlp.
- `youtube "<url|id|search>" [--app]` — YouTube playback.
- `open <url>` — any tvOS deep link. `launch <app>` — open an app.
- `remote <action>` — 26 buttons (navigation, media, control_center,
  screensaver, channel/volume up/down, suspend/wakeup).
- `volume [0-100|up|down]`, `seek <seconds>`, `repeat`, `shuffle`,
  `outputs [set <name>]`, `type "text" [--clear]`, `playing`,
  `power wake|sleep`, `apps`, `devices`, `scan`, `use <name>`.
- `--device <name>` before the subcommand targets a non-default TV.
- `pair [name]` registers a TV (PIN on screen; agents: ATV_PIN_FILE).

## Setup

Requires uv. Clone into ~/.claude/skills/appletv-remote, then
`uv run .../scripts/atv.py pair` once. Credentials:
~/.config/appletv-remote/devices.json (0600, private).

## Known limitations

- Netflix deep links unreliable since Sept 2025; use launch + type.
- DRM services cannot be extracted for `play`; use `watch`.
- Some sites (Vimeo) bot-block yt-dlp extraction (403).
- pyatv pinned to fork commit fixing play_url on tvOS 26 (PR #2846).
